title: Knowledge base
description: knowledge/<code>.yaml: a pointer to a knowledge base, never its content. The command line fetches the content onto each person's computer with that person's own access; it never passes through the server.

type.description: git: a directory of a Git repository.

repo.description: The repository's address: https://…, ssh://… or user@host:path. No password in it: each person reads the repository with their own access.

branch.description: A branch, tag or commit; the repository's default branch when left out.

dir.description: The directory inside the repository, with forward slashes; all of it when left out.

category.description: What kind of knowledge it is, for people and the AI, such as "engineering rules".
